definitions.gloss: to oversleep; to sleep past one's alarm or intended wake-up time
definitions.explanation: To sleep longer than planned, typically resulting in being late. A compound of 寝る (to sleep) and 過ごす (to pass/exceed).

examples.japanese: ⟦{今朝|けさ}→今朝：02877_kesa⟧{寝過|ねす}ごしてしまった。
⟦{目覚|めざ}まし→目覚まし：08550_mezamashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}らなくて→鳴る：01143_naru⟧{寝過|ねす}ごした。
examples.english: My alarm didn't go off, so I overslept.

examples.japanese: {昨夜|ゆうべ}⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{起|お}きていた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧せい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{寝過|ねす}ごして、⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遅刻|ちこく}して→遅刻する：22282_chikokusuru⟧しまった。
examples.english: Because I stayed up late last night, I overslept and was late for an important meeting.

notes:
Godan verb (す row): {寝過|ねす}ごす・{寝過|ねす}ごします
て-form: {寝過|ねす}ごして
た-form: {寝過|ねす}ごした

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦うっかり→うっかり：01863_ukkari⟧{寝過|ねす}ごす (to accidentally oversleep)
- {寝過|ねす}ごして⟦{遅刻|ちこく}する→遅刻する：22282_chikokusuru⟧ (to oversleep and be late)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{寝坊|ねぼう}する→寝坊する：16731_nebousuru⟧: Also means to oversleep, but is more commonly used in everyday conversation. {寝過|ねす}ごす emphasizes sleeping past a specific point, while ⟦{寝坊|ねぼう}する→寝坊する：16731_nebousuru⟧ simply means getting up late.
- ⟦{乗|の}り{過|す}ごす→乗り過ごす：07928_norisugosu⟧: To ride past one's stop — uses the same ～⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧ pattern.
